simulator.note: Boots as a 256 MB M3503 revision B board (chips/m3503.py, run_dump_hd8260_galaxy_2363_app_starts.py, run_dump_hd8260_galaxy_2363_capture_screen.py): the XIP bootloader ("M3516A 1.2.1") runs from flash using CacheAsRam at 0x8FFF8000..0x8FFFFFFF, prints "CH455 panel init OK!", writes " ON " to the CH455 panel on GPIO 135 / 134, parks the SEE boot stub at 0xA14187DC, unpacks seecode ("M3606 SEE") to 0xAE000200 and maincode(AV) ("14000A002363", 12.76 MB) to 0x80000200, and starts both cores (main EBase 0x80002000, SEE EBase 0x8E002001).  The application updates the CH455 panel to "-ON-" and renders its 1280x720 OSD dialog on GMA layer 0.

desc: Amiko HD8260+ (System ID 14000A00) Galaxy 2.3.63 by Dekolte firmware (2016-2-22) on a 16 MB SPI flash for the ALi M3516A / M3503 rev B Full HD receiver with 256 MB DDR3.
Uses an XIP CacheAsRam bootloader ("M3516A 1.2.1"), dual-CPU "M3606 SEE" firmware at 0xAE000200, and a CH455 4-digit LED front panel on GPIO 135 (SCL) / 134 (SDA).
